newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber falls on weak demand.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber falls on weak demand.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 rubber offer prices edged down in late trading on Tuesday due to weak demand as a market holiday in Tokyo dampened sentiment, traders said.
"Some traders further lowered their offer prices, but no deals were done so far," one trader said.
The trader said there were bids for July/August shipments at 46.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, but no deals were heard despite a lowering of the offer price to 46.75 cents from the 47.00.
Offer prices were at 46.25 fob Padang, at 46.50 fob Surabaya and at 46.00 fob Jambi and Pontianak.
Traders said the outlook for prices remained weak due to expected continued soft demand and sufficient supply.
